title: World Population Prospects 2024: Summary of Results
book_use: Chapter 9; The Shrinking Century; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: 8.2 billion world population in 2024; peak around 10.3 billion in the mid-2080s; approximately 10.2 billion in 2100; 80% estimated probability of an in-century peak; Limits: Projection, not observation; uncertainty ranges matter and later revisions may move in either direction.
